shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.description: Choose a mall store when searching.

bargain_hunting.name: Bargain Hunting
bargain_hunting.description: Improve the total chance of finding items in malls.

body_building.name: Body Building
body_building.description: Raise maximum HP to 60, including after death.

tagging.name: Tagging
tagging.description: Earn XP for useful exterior tags and make spray cans last longer.

construction.name: Construction
construction.description: Build beyond Strongly Barricaded, up to EHB. Use a toolbox to repair machinery and ruins.

radio_operation.name: Radio Operation
radio_operation.description: Install, tune and broadcast over radio transmitters.

firearms.name: Basic Firearms Training
firearms.description: Add 15 percentage points to pistol and shotgun accuracy.

advanced_pistol.name: Advanced Pistol Training
advanced_pistol.description: Add another 10 points to pistol accuracy.

advanced_shotgun.name: Advanced Shotgun Training
advanced_shotgun.description: Add another 10 points to shotgun accuracy.

hand_to_hand.name: Hand-to-Hand Combat
hand_to_hand.description: Add 15 points to melee and fist accuracy.

knife_combat.name: Knife Combat
knife_combat.description: Add 25 points to knife accuracy, reaching 50%.

axe_proficiency.name: Axe Proficiency
axe_proficiency.description: Add 30 points to fire axe accuracy, capped at 40%.

free_running.name: Free Running
free_running.description: Move directly between intact building interiors.

scout_safehouse.name: Scout Safehouse
scout_safehouse.description: Spend 30 AP scouting a shelter for five discounted actions each day.

necro_employment.name: NecroTech Employment
necro_employment.description: Operate DNA extractors and recognise NecroTech sites.

necronet.name: NecroNet Access
necronet.description: Scan tagged zombies, make syringes and revive Brain Rot in powered labs.

first_aid.name: First Aid
first_aid.description: First aid kits heal 10 HP instead of 5.

surgery.name: Surgery
surgery.description: Heal another 5 HP in powered hospitals and infirmaries.

diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
diagnosis.description: Read nearby survivor HP when visibility permits.

headshot.name: Headshot
headshot.description: Killed zombies need five additional AP to stand. Requires level 10.

scent_fear.name: Scent Fear
scent_fear.description: See exact HP for injured survivors in either form.

scent_blood.name: Scent Blood
scent_blood.description: Mark heavily injured survivors on the minimap with a red cross.

scent_trail.name: Scent Trail
scent_trail.description: Read the direction a nearby survivor fled and pursue their trail.

scent_death.name: Scent Death
scent_death.description: Count standing zombies on nearby minimap squares, including indoors.

digestion.name: Digestion
digestion.description: Bites restore HP; feed on corpses to recover four HP.

infectious_bite.name: Infectious Bite
infectious_bite.description: Successful bites infect survivors. Infection costs 1 HP per AP spent until cured by first aid.

vigour_mortis.name: Vigour Mortis
vigour_mortis.description: Add 10 points to claw accuracy, reaching 35%.

neck_lurch.name: Neck Lurch
neck_lurch.description: Unlock a bite at 30% accuracy for 4 damage.

rend_flesh.name: Rend Flesh
rend_flesh.description: Raise bite accuracy to 40% and bite damage to 5.

tangling_grasp.name: Tangling Grasp
tangling_grasp.description: A claw hit grips the survivor and lowers their attack accuracy by 10 points until released.

feeding_drag.name: Feeding Drag
feeding_drag.description: Drag dying or unconscious survivors through an open, clear entrance.

feeding_groan.name: Feeding Groan
feeding_groan.description: Call nearby zombies towards the survivors you face.

bellow.name: Bellow
bellow.description: Spend 10 AP to call a horde when facing at least 25 survivors.

ransack.name: Ransack
ransack.description: Ransack and ruin undefended buildings, blocking barricading and reducing loot.

flailing_gesture.name: Flailing Gesture
flailing_gesture.description: Point towards locations, objects or people.

lurching_gait.name: Lurching Gait
lurching_gait.description: Movement costs one AP instead of two.

death_lurch.name: Death Lurch
death_lurch.description: Stand for 5 AP and move one square for 1 AP.

ankle_grab.name: Ankle Grab
ankle_grab.description: Standing costs one AP, plus any Headshot penalty.

brain_rot.name: Brain Rot
brain_rot.description: Block DNA extraction. Revival costs 10 AP and needs a powered lab and NecroNet.

flesh_rot.name: Flesh Rot
flesh_rot.description: Raise zombie maximum HP to 60 and reduce firearm damage.
